descriptions.text: Make a colorful impression with our signature ink. Classic Stampin' Ink Refills come in exclusive Stampin' Up! colors, grouped in collections to take the guesswork out of product coordination. * Fast drying, dye-based ink * Flirty Flamingo * Acid free * Use to re-ink Classic Stampin’ Pads or use for spritzing or watercoloring * Coordinates with Stampin’ Up! cardstock, markers, and embellishments * 0.5 fl. oz. (14.8 ml)

images.description: A bottle of Stampin' Up Classic Stampin' Ink in Flirty Flamingo, a water-based dye ink. The small dropper bottle features a white cap and contains 0.5 fl oz (14.8 mL) of dark gray-black liquid ink. The label displays the product name and description in English, French, German, and Dutch.
images.full_text: CLASSIC STAMPIN'INK BY STAMPIN'UP! FLIRTY FLAMINGO Water-based dye ink FLAMANT FOUGQUEUX Encre teinture à base d'eau FLAMINGOCOT Farbstofftinte auf Wasserbasis FLIRTY FLAMINGO Kleurstoffinkt op waterbasis 0.5 FL OZ • 14.8 ML

images.description: A coral or salmon pink flower illustration on a white background, featuring a full bloom rose with layered petals and white highlight details. The design appears to be a single floral motif suitable for crafting projects.

141402.name: Flirty Flamingo Classic Stampin' Ink Refill

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it's dyed with pure color all the way through so there's no white core. * 24 sheets * Flirty Flamingo * 8-1/2" x 11" * Acid free * Lignin free

images.description: A single sheet of coral pink cardstock or paper product displayed against a light neutral background with subtle shadow. The product appears to be a blank, solid-colored card base or crafting paper with no visible texture or pattern.
A blank coral/salmon pink cardstock or paper product displayed on a neutral beige background with subtle shadowing, suggesting a single sheet or pad of quality cardmaking paper.

A gray and beige two-part punch tool featuring decorative floral and cloud designs on the top lid with a circular window display. The front panel shows matching flower and leaf motifs. This appears to be a crafting punch designed for creating coordinated cut-outs.

Metal cutting dies featuring bird and cloud designs in various sizes. The set includes multiple decorative bird silhouettes with detailed wing patterns, simple cloud shapes, and coordinating larger bird outline templates, all shown in gray steel with the characteristic outline style typical of craft cutting tools.

descriptions.text: Create custom die-cut patterns and shapes such as flowers, leaves, branches, and a border in record time using the Flourish Dies. Dies help you create unique die cuts with just a quick run through your die-cutting and embossing machine. Detailed dies include ejection holes so you can remove the paper easily. * 10 dies * Largest die: 4-1/2" x 2-1/2" (11.4 x 6.4 cm) * Use with a die-cutting and embossing machine

images.description: A collection of white lace-patterned die-cut or embellishment pieces displayed on a gray background, featuring intricate filigree designs including flowers, leaves, branches, and decorative borders in various sizes.

A gray and taupe paper punch tool with a distinctive oval opening and decorative wavy line design. The top circular opening shows the punch pattern with horizontal wavy lines, and the front panel displays a matching wavy line icon. This appears to be a specialized crafting punch for creating decorative paper cuts.

descriptions.text: Ribbon lovers, we’ve got you covered! Ribbon is an easy way to add style to your projects. Tie it, loop it, wrap it, cut it. We have the styles you love in the colors you want. * Loose-weave burlap * 5/8" (1.6 cm) wide * 5 yards (4.6 cm) * 75% jute, 25% nylon

images.description: A natural tan and cream colored ribbon or trim with a woven texture and striped pattern. The material appears to be fabric-based with visible individual strands creating a loose, open weave design. The ribbon is arranged in a curved loop formation against a neutral gray background.

A collection of decorative die-cut templates or stencils featuring various ribbon and banner shapes with gray borders on a cream-colored background. The set includes multiple designs: horizontal banners with pointed ends, wavy ribbon shapes, stacked banner elements, and small rectangular labels, displaying a range of sizes and styles suitable for cardmaking or paper crafting.

descriptions.text: Punches are a quick and easy way to add interest and depth to your projects. And there’s no better way to cut out stamped images—many of our stamp sets have coordinating punches. Our punches are high quality, affordable, and easy to use. * Sleek body style * Large surface area offers precise cutting and leverage * Locks to store * Slim and stackable

images.description: A brown/taupe colored craft punching tool with a circular design chamber on top featuring a white slot opening. Three light blue decorative strips are displayed beside the device, showing sample output from the punch.

descriptions.text: Turn stamped images into glossy raised designs. Just use VersaMark Pad, powder, and Heat Tool. * 1/2 oz. (14 g) * Copper

images.description: A clear cylindrical plastic jar containing fine glitter powder in a shimmering bronze or copper tone with subtle iridescent rainbow reflections. The jar has a clear screw-top lid and is photographed against a neutral gray background.

A black cord or twine product arranged in three loop formations on a gray textured surface. The material appears to be crafted twine or decorative cord, displayed in a continuous strand showing multiple oval-shaped loops.

A coil of copper-colored wire or twine arranged in a circular shape on a dark textured background. The wire appears to be thin and flexible, with multiple strands twisted together, displaying a warm metallic copper finish.

descriptions.text: Fill up these clear acetate boxes with tiny treats, and add a personal touch for that special someone. * 16 boxes * 2" x 2" x 2" (5.1 x 5.1 x 5.1 cm) * Food safe * Acid free

images.description: Clear plastic packaging boxes shown in two styles - flat unassembled templates on the left and an assembled box on the right filled with red shredded paper filler material. The boxes feature a white insert lid and transparent walls, designed for product display and packaging.

descriptions.text: Use these bags for treat or gift bags. Just pop the treat or gift into one of our shiny cellophane bags and add a stamped header. These bags are also great for storing finished projects, parts for future projects, or any other odds and ends. * 25 gusseted bags * 3" x 6" (7.6 x 15.2 cm) * Stampable with StazOn ink * Food safe * Acid free

images.description: A clear cellophane package containing bright coral/orange shredded paper fill material, shown alongside an empty transparent package for comparison. The product appears to be decorative packaging fill or crinkle paper used for gift wrapping or product presentation.

141704.name: 3" X 6" (7.6 X 15.2 Cm) Gusseted Cellophane Bags

images.description: Four white decorative circular die-cut frames with nested scalloped edges arranged in a 2x2 grid. Each frame features multiple concentric circles with delicate scallop patterns, creating an ornate, layered effect suitable for cardmaking or paper crafting projects.

A set of four nested oval die-cutting templates in various styles arranged on a gray background. Two feature smooth straight edges with concentric oval designs, while two feature decorative scalloped/wavy edges. All dies are white and appear to be layered cutting tools designed for cardmaking or papercrafting.

A set of four nested square die templates featuring decorative scalloped and stitched borders in white and gray. Each template contains multiple concentric squares with varying border styles, designed for layering and card-making projects.

descriptions.text: High-quality, smooth color pencils. Perfect for watercoloring stamped images. Use with Aqua Painters, Blender Pens, or alone. * 13 pencils in Stampin’ Up! colors: Basic Black, Basic Gray, Bermuda Bay, Calypso Coral, Daffodil Delight, Early Espresso, Melon Mambo, Old Olive, Pacific Point, Pumpkin Pie, Real Red, Rich Razzleberry, Whisper White * Acid free * Lignin free

images.description: A set of 13 colored pencils with black barrels and sharpened tips in various colors ranging from red to gray. Each pencil displays color-coded bands at the bottom and white text labeling. Above the pencils is a color swatch card showing the corresponding marks each pencil makes.

descriptions.text: Use for ink techniques. * 2 handles and 4 sponges * Sponges: 1-3/4" (4.4 cm) wide

images.description: A foam applicator tool with a black plastic handle and white foam head, displayed on grid paper next to a swatch showing a blue gradient watercolor or ink application. The tool demonstrates how the foam applicator creates soft, blended color effects.

descriptions.text: Make your own small ink pads in the colors you need with Uninked Stampin' Spots and Classic Stampin' Ink Refills. * Felt Stampin’ Spots for use with ink refills * Pack of 5

images.description: Set of six clear acrylic storage containers with square shapes arranged in two rows, plus one white container with a textured white insert pad at the top. The clear containers feature transparent sides with thin border frames, designed for organizing and displaying small items. All containers are photographed against a neutral beige background.

descriptions.text: Sheet of adhesive white foam strips for shaker and spinner cards. *1/8" x 9" (3.2 mm x 22.9 cm) * 10 yards (9.1 m) total

images.description: A collection of white lined paper products displayed on a cream background, including what appears to be notepads or paper sheets of varying widths. The items feature horizontal ruling lines and are arranged to show depth and dimension.

A decorative craft organizer or storage tray featuring a turquoise scalloped frame with white interior compartments. The product displays various craft embellishments including hexagonal sequins in silver, iridescent, and clear finishes, along with metallic beads and stones in gold and mixed colors arranged in the tray. A finger is visible holding or presenting the product.

A collection of decorative metal die-cutting templates featuring ornate frames, borders, and embellishments in silver/gray tones. The set includes four distinct designs: a scalloped frame with circular medallion, a rectangular frame with patterned fill, an elaborate tag with shoe motif, and a circular frame with spiral detail. Each piece features decorative swirls and dimensional elements suitable for cardmaking or paper crafting.

A collection of decorative star and snowflake designs featuring six different metal die-cut templates in various styles, including ornate filigree snowflakes, geometric stars, and dotted pattern stars in silver and gray tones on a cream-colored background.

A gray and white punch tool featuring decorative shape cutouts on the top lid, including stars, leaves, and circles. The device has a cream-colored base with a star and sparkle design on the front panel. This appears to be a handheld crafting punch for creating decorative shapes in paper and cardstock.

A handheld punch tool in taupe and light gray colors featuring a bell-shaped design icon on the top lid and a matching icon on the front panel. The device has a lever mechanism on the right side for operation and appears to be made of durable plastic material.

A collection of decorative craft elements featuring hand-drawn style illustrations in black ink on a cream background. The set includes three textured ovals, two bow designs, several botanical elements with leaves and branches, and fern-like fronds in varying sizes. The designs appear to be printed on a lightweight surface suitable for crafting projects.

descriptions.text: Add sparkle to your projects without the mess. The Wink of Stella Glitter Brush is perfect for writing and adding subtle controlled glitter to stamped images. The brush tip produces thick and thin lines, allowing artistic freedom. * Clear * Archival quality * Acid free * Xylene free

images.description: A white marker or brush pen with a clear barrel top and a gray/blue brush tip. The product features a white cylindrical body with a label band in the middle displaying text that includes 'MINK' and 'BRUSH'. This appears to be a dual-ended or specialized brush tool, likely for crafting or artistic applications.

141897.name: Clear Wink Of Stella Glitter Brush

descriptions.text: Texture has been made even easier: * Mix a few drops of Classic Stampin’ Ink to Embossing Paste * Apply over decorative masks, let dry * May use without ink for white texture * Matte finish * 4 fl oz (118 ml)

images.description: Product demonstration image showing a white cream or paste product in a clear bowl alongside a gray card displaying an imprint or swatch of the same white product against a neutral linen background.

Stampin' Up product display featuring a white cosmetic jar with cream product, a white applicator brush with cream sample, a metallic pump bottle, and decorative patterned paper samples in navy blue and taupe with geometric leaf motifs.

A collection of four decorative cardstock or paper sheets in coordinating colors featuring white embossed or debossed patterns. The set includes a peach/salmon colored sheet with geometric triangle pattern, a coral/red sheet with scalloped circle design, a sage green sheet with floral damask pattern, and a taupe/brown sheet with ornate baroque scroll motif. Each sheet displays intricate white surface designs creating visual depth and texture.
